newsitem.title: JAPAN: Deutsche Telekom down on profit-taking in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom down on profit-taking in Tokyo.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom shares, which debuted on the foreign stocks section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday, fell prey to profit-taking in Wednesday's morning session, brokers said.
As of 0047 GMT, the shares were lower by 40 yen at 2,400.
On Tuesday, the shares fetched an initial strike price of 2,500 yen on the TSE.
Unlike in the U.S. and Frankfurt bourses, where the shares were listed on Monday and raked in hefty gains, the shares were pressured by profit-taking in Tokyo and failed to rise.
